title: Disable systemd backlight restore
summary: Prevent systemd-backlight from restoring the previous brightness at boot, which can conflict with other backlight methods.

steps.explain: Edit your bootloader configuration (e.g., GRUB or systemd-boot) to include the kernel parameter systemd.restore_state=0.

rollback.explain: Remove the kernel parameter from your bootloader configuration.

warnings: This requires editing bootloader configuration files.
Reboot is required for changes to take effect.
